source: Seeded from geography/y11 lesson 34 (Own 4GE1-style exam questions with indicative mark points (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 34: Human fieldwork enquiry: Section B practice (Paper 2). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Section B practice (20 marks, portal printable): (a) Describe one primary method you used and justify it. (4) (b) Using the data table, calculate the mean EQS for the inner and outer zones. (2) (c) Suggest an appropriate graph and justify it. (3) (d) Explain one limitation of your sampling. (3) (e) Evaluate the reliability of your conclusions. (8)
questions.a: Indicative mark points on the portal key: method with justification; correct means; scatter or bar graph justified; e.g. small sample, single day; evaluation weighing method, sample, data and conclusion
questions.model: Teacher models (a) using the transect EQS example.

questions.q: Write a hypothesis for a different human enquiry and name two methods.
questions.a: e.g. 'Pedestrian numbers fall with distance from the centre': pedestrian counts, land use survey

questions.model: Put in order. Find the middle value. 9, 12, 15, 16, 18. Median: 15.
